metadata.description: Skill Autopilot — surfaces the installed skills most relevant to what you're doing, so the right one isn't forgotten. Also offers fitting high-leverage commands; handles the basics silently; never nags. Open source, zero telemetry, local-first.

plugins.name: skill-autopilot
plugins.description: Each turn, surfaces your most prompt-relevant installed skills (and fitting high-leverage commands) so the right move is in front of you; handles the basics silently; never nags.
